item.text:
**8B.7**

Bottom line: mostly no. In 2024, the clearest outcome indicators did not broadly move in the direction Khamenei said he wanted for the economy or the nuclear file. There were a few narrow positives, mainly temporary de-escalation and late procedural nuclear restraint, but the larger indicators were flat or negative: economic hardship stayed severe, turnout and legitimacy fell, environmental stress worsened, and nuclear verification deteriorated.

**Positive / Partial**
- [Khamenei and Raisi Speeches on Nowruz](https://iranprimer.usip.org/index.php/blog/2024/mar/21/khamenei-and-raisi-speeches-nowruz) | The Iran Primer / USIP | 2024-03-21 | Claim: Khamenei said domestic production was the answer to inflation, jobs, and currency weakness, and that foreign agreements should become “national executive contracts” with tangible results. This sets the outcome direction he wanted, but it is still a target statement rather than evidence of achieved results. IDs: `8B.7`, `8B.1`, `8B.6`, `8B.2`
- [Tehran signals no retaliation against Israel after drones attack](https://www.theprint.in/world/tehran-signals-no-retaliation-against-israel-after-drones-attack/2048236/) | Reuters / ThePrint | 2024-04-19 | Claim: Tehran downplayed the Isfahan incident and signaled no retaliation, which Reuters said appeared aimed at averting wider war. This is a real de-escalatory outcome, but it was tactical and short-lived. IDs: `8B.7`, `8B.3`, `8B.2`
- [Iran will not impede IAEA access, head of its atomic organisation says](https://theprint.in/world/iran-will-not-impede-iaea-access-head-of-its-atomic-organisation-says/2403254/) | Reuters / ThePrint | 2024-12-14 | Claim: Iran said it would not obstruct IAEA inspections and would work within safeguards. This is narrow late-year procedural restraint, not broad success, but it does move in the intended non-escalatory direction. IDs: `8B.7`, `8B.6`, `8B.2`, `7B.6`
- [Irán acepta no producir uranio cercano al uso militar pero Occidente exige más cooperación](https://es.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/iran-acepta-no-producir-uranio-cercano-al-uso-militar-pero-occidente-exige-mas-cooperacion-2921557) | Reuters / Investing.com | 2024-11-20 | Claim: Iran accepted a technical step to stop enriching to 60% and took initial technical steps, conditional on the IAEA board not passing a resolution. This is the best concrete restraint signal in the nuclear file, but it was conditional and fragile. IDs: `8B.7`, `8B.6`, `8B.2`, `7B.6`

**Negative / Offsetting**
- [IAEA Board passes resolution against Iran on cooperation, inspectors](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/iaea-board-passes-resolution-against-iran-on-cooperation-inspectors-3472087) | Reuters / Investing.com | 2024-06-05 | Claim: the IAEA board called on Iran to reverse its barring of inspectors and said Iran still had not given satisfactory answers on undeclared-site traces. This is a direct negative outcome for verification and nuclear discipline. IDs: `8B.7`, `8B.6`, `8B.2`, `7B.6`
- [Iran's water crisis leads to alarming ground collapse](https://amp.dw.com/en/irans-water-crisis-leads-to-alarming-ground-collapse/a-69405927) | DW | 2024-06-19 | Claim: drought and subsidence threatened Tehran and 800+ towns, with at least half of society affected and chronic mismanagement worsening the crisis. This is strong evidence that a major state-service outcome moved away from better governance or welfare. IDs: `8B.7`, `8B.5`, `8B.2`
- [Iran vote turnout hits historic low amid discontent](https://www.theprint.in/world/iran-vote-turnout-hits-historic-low-amid-discontent/1986385/) | Reuters / ThePrint | 2024-03-02 | Claim: turnout was around 41%, the lowest since 1979, amid economic woes and discontent. That is a negative legitimacy outcome even after allowing for repression and restrictions. IDs: `8B.7`, `8B.5`, `8B.4`, `8B.2`
- [Khamenei protege, sole moderate neck and neck in Iran presidential race](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/iran-holds-presidential-vote-with-limited-choices-3500514) | Reuters / Investing.com | 2024-06-27 | Claim: voter apathy was driven by economic hardship and social restrictions, and candidates avoided concrete economic plans. This suggests the economic trajectory was not visibly improving in line with Khamenei’s March program. IDs: `8B.7`, `8B.2`, `8B.1`

**Search Gap**
- I did not find a direct 2024 macro series tied to Khamenei’s “domestic production” program showing inflation, jobs, or currency stabilizing after realistic lags. The available outcome proxies point negative or flat, so the best-supported reading is that his declared economic goals were not translating into clearly improved outcomes in 2024.
